reference.notes:
I implemented `NameRegistry` in `src/index.ts`, and every test passes: 14/14 in the public suite and 27/27 in the private one.

How it works:
- **Errors:** creating a registry with an empty key throws, and so does naming a task with an empty id.
- **Naming:** a task's digest is HMAC-SHA256 of its id under the key, as lowercase hex. Its name is `project-` plus the first 4 characters. If that name is already taken in the registry, the suffix grows to 6, 8 and so on characters until a free name turns up.
- **Same name every time:** each registry remembers the name it gave each task. Naming a task again returns that name, so whichever task was named first keeps the short one.
- **Separate organizations:** each registry keeps its own record of names in use, so two registries can hand out the same name.

The spec doesn't say what happens if every length up to the full 64-character digest is taken. That would need two tasks with identical digests, which in practice can't happen. I made it throw an error.
